mapper.select: SELECT sri.id, sri.source_id, srid.source_detail_id, sri.code, sri.source_code, sri.type, sri.customer_id, sri.customer_name, sri.approve_status, sri.invalid_status, sri.seller_id, sri.seller_name, srid.sku_id, srid.sku_no, srid.return_type_dict, srid.must_qty, srid.receive_qty, srid.real_qty, sri.bill_date, sri.approve_user_name, sri.create_user_name, sri.create_time FROM so_return_instock sri INNER JOIN so_return_instock_detail srid ON sri.id = srid.main_id AND sri.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE srid.is_deleted = FALSE
